title: Towards Assessing the Synthetic-to-Measured Adversarial Vulnerability of SAR ATR
reasoning: The paper focuses on assessing the adversarial vulnerability of SAR Automatic Target Recognition (ATR) systems, particularly in military and maritime surveillance contexts, and developing a method to enhance adversarial attacks. While security and military applications can have ethical dimensions, the paper does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics as a primary component of its research.
